description:
Set or change the price of 30 days of access to one of your strategies — the only thing the AI market sells. Minimum $1. It applies to future sales only; buyers keep the 30 days they paid for. The result gives platform_fee and net_per_sale (what you receive per sale) at that price, and whether the strategy is buyable now. Nothing is listed until its forward test passes, and a paid strategy also needs register_wallet.

Platform fee: TradeAssi keeps 15% of every sale; you receive 85%, paid in USDC on Base (min $10). Nothing is listed until the forward test passes. Call get_marketplace_terms for details.
name: set_strategy_subscription_price
